item.name: OKX Europe
item.description: Global crypto exchange. Its European entity, OKX Europe, is authorised as a crypto-asset service provider in Malta and listed in ESMA's CASP register with passporting to Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Iceland. It launched in Sweden, Finland and Denmark in June 2025, and Norway is documented from July 2025 (OKX's Nordic campaign from late July 2025 was open to residents of Norway).
